title: The conflict-markers guard asks when its git read cannot run
why: A git read that times out or fails left the conflict-markers check silent, so a commit with markers could pass unread.
note: Filed 09:49 CST Nov 8 from the coordinator's ask of 07:56 CST. Doing in lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers as #2083; round 1 FAIL, fixes in build (lane, 09:48 CST).
